# lumos_pre_approval_rules (Data Source)

A pre-approval rule: access requests for an app that Lumos approves without a reviewer when the requester matches the rule's condition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every pre-approval rule of the app.
data "lumos_pre_approval_rules" "deploy_dashboard" {
  app_id = "<app id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `pre_approval_rules` (Attributes List) The app's pre-approval rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pre_approval_rules))

<a id="nestedatt--pre_approval_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pre_approval_rules`

Read-Only:

- `app_id` (String) The ID of the app the rule applies to. For an app merged into another app, use the ID of the app it was merged into.
- `condition` (String) Who the rule pre-approves, and for how long they can have access, as a Lumos condition read back in the expanded `{ label, value }` form. Parsed as JSON.
- `id` (String) UUID of this pre-approval rule.
- `justification` (String) Justification shown to requesters and reviewers for why this rule exists.
- `request_does_not_include_entitlements` (Set of String) IDs of the entitlements the rule doesn't cover, in lowercase. The rule covers every other entitlement and a request for the app itself. Empty unless the rule lists the entitlements it excludes.
- `request_has_entitlements` (Boolean) `true` covers a request for any of the app's entitlements. `false` covers only a request for the app itself. Null when the rule lists entitlements.
- `request_includes_entitlements` (Set of String) IDs of the entitlements the rule covers, in lowercase. The rule covers no other entitlement, and not a request for the app itself. Empty unless the rule lists the entitlements it covers.
